text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels in March.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
Chang Song - (built 1968) 15,686 dwt sold for $171.50 plt for delivery India/Bangladesh options.
Asia Moon - (built 1968) 19,536 dwt sold for $167 plt to India.
V Star - (built 1970) 24,407 dwt sold for $170 plt delivery India.
Oriental Way - (built 1968) 26,434 dwt sold for $156 plt as is delivery Mongla.
Jag Shakti - (built 1972) 26,643 dwt sold for $168 plt for delivery India.
De Liang - (built 1972) 33,880 dwt sold for $171.50 plt for delivery India/Bangladesh options.
Mactrader - (built 1974) 79,760 dwt sold for $174 plt to India.
American Son - (built 1974) 78,750 dwt sold for $174 plt for delivery India.
Choyang Land - (built 1972) 13,349 dwt sold for $174 plt for delivery India.
Suez - (built 1973) 12,800 dwt sold for $168 plt for delivery India.
Slavyansk - (built 1967) 12,887 dwt sold for $170 plt for delivery India.
Kittanning - (built 1977) 90,000 dwt sold for $196 plt basis delivery India.
